title: A Melted Chocolate Bar Invented The Microwave 🍫
caption:
Percy Spencer noticed his chocolate melting next to a radar tube in 1945, and the microwave oven was born. 🍫
Microwaves shake water molecules billions of times a second, but only a few centimetres deep.
Best invention ever, or crime against leftovers?
sources: Smithsonian Magazine / Raytheon history: Percy Spencer, the magnetron and the melted candy bar (1945); first Radarange (1947) about 1.8 m tall, about 340 kg
Microwave ovens operate at 2.45 GHz; penetration depth in food is typically about 1-2 cm, the inside heats by conduction
